1: Compute the value of (sqrt(5) + 2*sqrt(3))^2. A. 11  B. 17  C. 17+4*sqrt(15)  D. 17+2*sqrt(15)
2: The number $\sqrt[4]{9\cdot\sqrt{3}}$ can be written in the form: A. $3^{\frac{5}{8}}$  B. $3^{\frac{11}{4}}$  C. $3^{\frac{1}{4}}$  D. $3^{\frac{9}{8}}$
3: The number 2*log(5) + 3*log(2) is equal to: A. log(2*5)+log(3*2)  B. log(2^5)+log(3^2)  C. 2*3*log(5*2)  D. log(5^2*2^3)
4: The smallest integer satisfying the inequality 5(4-x)/2 < x is the number: A. 1  B. 2  C. 3  D. 4
5: A data set of 250 numbers contains only the values 4 and 2. The value 4 occurs 128 times, and the value 2 occurs 122 times. The arithmetic mean of this data set is approximated by the number 3. Find the absolute error of this approximation. A. 0.024  B. 0.24  C. 0.0024  D. 0.00024
6: At the start of a month a computer cost 3500 zl. Later that month its price was reduced by 10%, and then reduced again by 15%. There were no other price changes that month. Find the computer's price at the end of the month. A. 3272.50 zl  B. 2625 zl  C. 2677.50 zl  D. 2800 zl
7: Linear functions f and g are given by f(x)=-4x+12 and g(x)=-2x+k+3 and share a common zero. It follows that: A. k=-6  B. k=-3  C. k=3  D. k=6
8: The range of the quadratic function f given by f(x)=-(x+9)^2+m is the interval (-infinity, -5]. Then: A. m=5  B. m=-5  C. m=-9  D. m=9
9: The axis of symmetry of the graph of the quadratic function f given by f(x)=(1/3)x^2+4x+7 is the line: A. x=-6  B. y=-6  C. x=-2  D. y=-2
11: The solution of the equation (x^2-3x)/(x^2+x) = 0 is the number: A. -3  B. 0  C. 3  D. 9
12: Point P=(1,3) lies on a circle centered at S=(2,4). The circumference of this circle is equal to: A. 4*pi*sqrt(2)  B. 3*pi*sqrt(2)  C. 2*pi*sqrt(2)  D. pi*sqrt(2)
14: Point S=(4,8) is the midpoint of segment PQ, whose endpoint P lies on the Oy axis and endpoint Q lies on the Ox axis. It follows that: A. P=(0,16) and Q=(8,0)  B. P=(0,8) and Q=(16,0)  C. P=(0,4) and Q=(4,0)  D. P=(0,8) and Q=(8,0)
15: In right triangle ABC, leg AC has length 6, and altitude CD divides it into two triangles ADC and CDB such that the area of ADC is 4 times the area of CDB (see figure). Find the length of leg BC. A. 1.5  B. 2  C. 2.5  D. 3
16: Points P=(-3,4) and O=(0,0) lie on one line. Angle alpha is the angle of inclination of this line to the Ox axis (see figure). Find tan(alpha). A. -3/4  B. -4/3  C. 4/3  D. 3/4
17: Angle alpha is acute and sin(alpha) = 2*sqrt(5)/5. Then: A. cos(alpha)=5/(2*sqrt5)  B. cos(alpha)=sqrt5/5  C. cos(alpha)=1/5  D. cos(alpha)=4/5
19: A function f is given by f(x)=(1/2)^x for all real x. Find the value of f at x=-3. A. 1/6  B. 1/8  C. 6  D. 8
20: Quantities x and y are inversely proportional (table below): x: a, 3, 8; y: 36, 24, b. Find a and b. A. a=6, b=22.5  B. a=4/3, b=6  C. a=3, b=96  D. a=2, b=9
22: Points A=(4,1), B=(1,3), C=(4,-1) are given. Find the area of triangle ABC. A. 3  B. 6  C. 8  D. 16
23: How many 4-digit natural numbers less than 2020 are divisible by 4? A. 506  B. 505  C. 256  D. 255
24: A prism and a pyramid have congruent bases. The number of all vertices of the prism is 9 greater than the number of all vertices of the pyramid. The base of each of these solids is: A. a nonagon  B. an octagon  C. an octadecagon  D. a decagon
25: The total surface area of a cube is 12. Find the sum of the lengths of all edges of this cube. A. 6*sqrt(2)  B. 3*sqrt(2)  C. 12*sqrt(2)  D. 8*sqrt(2)
27: A three-term sequence (x+2, 4x+2, x+11) is given. Find all values of x for which this sequence is geometric.
31: A box contains 8 balls: 5 white and 3 black. n white balls are added to the box. An experiment consists of drawing one ball from the box. The probability of drawing a white ball is 11/12. Find n.
32: An isosceles triangle ABC has base AB of length 12, and each leg AC and BC has length 10. Point D is the midpoint of leg BC (see figure). Find the sine of angle alpha formed by median AD with leg AC of triangle ABC.
33: The lateral surface area of a cone is three times the area of its base. The height of the cone is 12. Compute the volume of this cone.
34: The line with equation y=-2x+7 is the perpendicular bisector of segment PQ, where P=(4,5). Find the coordinates of point Q.
